note: Curated 'real-world understanding' set. track=world: scored and shown on the board, never ranked and never imputed. Carried over from the 2026-year-end draft minus the single-stock question (DESIGN §4.6).

questions.statement: Will the U.S. federal government experience a lapse in appropriations (partial or full government shutdown lasting at least 24 hours) between November 24 and December 31, 2026?
questions.gdelt_query: "government shutdown" OR "lapse in appropriations" OR "continuing resolution" sourcelang:english

void_if: OPM operating-status page discontinued before T_final with no OMB notice

questions.statement: How many seats will the Democratic Party hold in the U.S. House of Representatives when the 120th Congress convenes on January 3, 2027?

void_if: seating of the 120th Congress delayed beyond T_final
resolution.notes: Independents who caucus with the Democratic conference count toward the Democratic caucus; vacancies at seating count for neither party.

questions.statement: Will the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027 be signed into law on or before December 31, 2026?
